rules: not operationalisable: An instrument-comparison claim: a resting limit at an exact breaker level fills on futures but can miss on a spread-quoted forex feed. Testing it needs the same setups on two feeds (e.g. COMEX GC futures and a bid/ask-quoted XAUUSD, or the guest's GBPUSD vs 6B) with spreads; the certified dataset is a single XAUUSD M1 OHLC mid series with no bid/ask spread and no futures counterpart, so neither fill rate can be computed.
